title: 第11章 意外第12章 十年前的李相夷
content_zh:
这两个时辰不止药魔过的提心吊胆，大家过的都很不安稳。李莲花躺在床上，不停的揪着自己的前襟，眉头紧锁，满脸通红，好像一直在和什么人打架。
方多病坐在床边，看着李莲花如此难受，恨不得自己替他遭这一趟罪，可转念一想，李莲花熬过这回，以后就会高枕无忧了。
笛飞声看着李莲花这样难受，也是于心不忍，自己一人出去在院中独坐。
毕竟当年是角丽谯给李相夷下的碧茶之毒，下毒还是因为自己，这简直是对自己最大的羞辱。他这辈子如今最后悔的事就是救了角丽谯，这蛇蝎心肠的女人。以前他还笑话李相夷识人不清，如今看来最大的笑话竟是自己。
“笛飞声，笛飞声，笛飞声……”李莲花嘴中喃喃自语。
方多病听他在昏迷中还在念叨笛飞声的名字，心中有些不是滋味，可转念一想，这也许是李莲花正在找回记忆，说不定这一觉醒来，李莲花又会变回那只老狐狸。老狐狸也不错，总比现今这样的好！
李莲花越叫越大声，后面更是无意识的大喊出口，笛飞声听见屋中人大喊自己名字，以为李莲花已经清醒，急忙忙推门而入，而此时正好李莲花张开眼睛。
他瞪眼看见笛飞声近前，挣扎着坐起身，扑向笛飞声，双手揪住笛飞声的衣领，大声喝道：“笛飞声，我师兄单孤刀的尸体在哪里？”
一时屋中安静无声，大家竟不知怎样回答李莲花的问题。
笛飞声伸手握住李莲花的胳膊，帮他撑住身体。
方多病抢身上前，将李莲花整个人抱在怀中，又怕他摔倒，口中只喊他名字：“李莲花，李莲花，你怎么样啊？你可不要吓我！”
没想到，李莲花好似没听见一般，只直直盯着笛飞声的眼睛，一边挣扎的扑向笛飞声一边质问：“你到底把我师兄的尸体藏在何处？”
“李相夷？”笛飞声发觉此人如今并不是李莲花，而是十年前东海一战中的李相夷。
“别装糊涂，你我约好东海一战，我来应战，我师兄……”话还没有说完，却被人一掌击中后颈，又晕了过去。
笛飞声立马瞪向打晕李莲花的人，这出手之人正是药魔。
“启禀尊上，此时不能让他过于激动。”药魔战战兢兢的开口，他见自家主人和这天机山庄的少庄主心慈手软，不肯动手，只好自己来当这个恶人……
笛飞声也知药魔说的是实话，看见方多病又把李莲花放回床上，开口问道：“怎么会这样？”
“人脑是一个很奇妙的器官，如今还有许多未知之数。”药魔自己也不清楚，急忙又上前把脉，倒确实有一件值得高兴的事：“恭喜尊上，李门主碧茶之毒已解，至于……”
“说！”
“至于李门主记忆混乱这件事，要等他醒了之后才能问询。”

“人什么时候能醒？”
“也许两个时辰，也许要到明早，总之要做好准备。”药魔又想了一想，“李门主身边一定要有人看守。”
“好，我会守着他！”不等笛飞声开口，方多病抢先答道，同时心中也不是滋味：李相夷，难道真的是李相夷回来了，他要是不记得李莲花了，那我该怎么办呢？难道真要拜师不成？
方多病又看着李莲花刚才用力过猛而泛白的指尖，心想怎么如此之虚，又想着等李莲花再醒过来，无论如何都要好好给他补一补。
就这样，方多病胡思乱想间，一夜过去了，李莲花还是会时不时的喊着笛飞声的名字，小声的喃喃自语，方多病将耳尖凑近了才听清楚，原来他还是在一直在质问单孤刀的遗体在哪？
方多病此时真的想把单孤刀揪出来教训一顿，怎么别人一直追寻的真心，单孤刀却是毫不在意？不仅不在意，还为了那虚无缥缈的复国梦而随意践踏？真是害人害己！
还好，自己一点儿也不像他！李相夷要是自己的师弟，方多病恐怕梦中都会笑醒，一定会把全天下最甜的糖捧到他面前，哪怕他要自己的命方多病都不会眨一下眼睛。
就这样，又过去了两个时辰，期间笛飞声来看过一回，药魔来把了一回脉，就连平时隐形的无颜都来远远的看过一回，当又只剩下方多病一人看守时，李莲花醒了。
“笛飞声去哪了？”这是李莲花醒来之后说的第一句话，第二句是：“你是谁？”
“我是方多病，单孤刀是我舅舅！”方多病已经做好了心理准备，当他说出这句话时，内心竟然很平静。
“舅舅？”李莲花闭了闭眼睛，好像在回忆什么。“不可能，我刚见过，他才八岁！”
“已经过去十年了。”方多病决定实话实说。
李相夷也好李莲花也好，都是内心强大的人，虽然李莲花喜欢套路别人，可却希望别人对他赤诚相待。
“十年？！”李莲花一惊之下，翻身想要坐起，却发现自己手脚无力，“我的腿？”
“你的腿没事儿，我扶着你你慢慢坐起来。”方多病坐到李莲花身边，胳膊使劲，让李莲花靠坐在自己身上，伸手去拿床边矮桌上的粥，那是无颜刚刚送来的。
“喝点粥吧！你已经一天一夜没进食了。”说着就想用勺子将粥水喂入李莲花口中。
此时的李莲花是十年前的李相夷，李相夷朦朦胧胧中知道是眼前的少年照顾了自己一夜，他又说自己是师兄的外甥，这人又如此温柔的喂自己喝粥，怎能负了这少年的好意，他又动了动自己的左手，一手抢过碗来，扬脖一口喝尽碗中的粥水。
他其实没有胃口，师兄的事使他心急如焚。
一睁眼十年过去了，他躺在床上身体虚弱至此，而笛飞声却看着武功更进一步！师兄的尸体又去哪了？
这些疑问得不到解答，别说是喝粥了，就是龙肉摆在面前也不想吃一口。

“我又不是女子，何必如此做作，无需勺子！”李相夷看了少年一眼，心想男儿郎应该要痛痛快快才好。
“再来一碗嘛？”方多病并未将李相夷的举动放在心中，李相夷本就该活的这样痛快，“一会儿还要服药。”
“你将笛飞声叫来，我要问他我师兄的事情！”
“等你喝完药，我来讲给你听。”
方多病见他如此执着，只好将他放回床上，出门去拿药魔煨在炉上的补药。
content_en:
During these two hours, not only Yao Mo was on tenterhooks, but everyone was also living a very unsettled life. Li Lianhua was lying on the bed, grabbing her front frequently, her brows furrowed and her face flushed, as if she had been fighting with someone.
Fang Duobing sat by the bed, seeing how uncomfortable Li Lianhua was, wishing that he would suffer for him, but then he thought about it, if Li Lianhua survives this time, he will be able to sit back and relax in the future.
Di Feisheng couldn't bear to see Li Lianhua in such pain, so he went out and sat alone in the courtyard.
After all, it was Jiao Liqiao who poisoned Li Xiangyi back then, and the poison was caused by him. This was simply the greatest humiliation to himself. The thing he regrets most in his life now is saving Jiao Liqiao, this woman with a heart of snake and scorpion. He used to laugh at Li Xiangyi for not knowing people well, but now it seems that the biggest joke is himself.
"The sound of the flute flying, the sound of the flute flying, the sound of the flute flying..." Li Lianhua murmured to herself.
Fang Duobing felt a little uncomfortable when he heard that he was still chanting Di Feisheng's name in his coma, but then he thought about it, maybe Li Lianhua was regaining his memory, and maybe when he woke up, Li Lianhua would turn back into the old fox. The old fox was not bad, it was better than what he is doing now!
Li Lianhua screamed louder and louder, and even more unconscious shouts followed. Di Feisheng heard the people in the room shouting his name, thinking that Li Lianhua was awake, and hurriedly opened the door and entered. At this time, Li Lianhua opened his eyes.
He stared and saw Di Feisheng approaching, struggled to sit up, rushed towards Di Feisheng, grabbed Di Feisheng's collar with both hands, and shouted loudly: "Di Feisheng, where is the body of my senior brother Dan Gudao?"
The room was silent for a while, and everyone didn't know how to answer Li Lianhua's question.
Di Feisheng reached out and held Li Lianhua's arm to help him support his body.
Fang Duobing rushed forward and held Li Lianhua in his arms. He was afraid that he would fall, so he only called his name: "Li Lianhua, Li Lianhua, how are you? Don't scare me!"
Unexpectedly, Li Lianhua didn't seem to hear anything and just stared straight into Di Feisheng's eyes. While struggling towards Di Feisheng, he asked: "Where did you hide my senior brother's body?"
"Li Xiangyi?" Di Feisheng realized that this person was not Li Lianhua now, but Li Xiangyi who had fought in the East China Sea ten years ago.
"Don't pretend to be confused. You and I have made an appointment to fight in the East China Sea. I will accept the challenge. My senior brother..." Before he could finish his words, someone hit him on the back of his neck and he fainted again.
Di Feisheng immediately glared at the person who knocked Li Lianhua unconscious. The person who took action was none other than Yao Mo.
"Your Majesty, please don't let him get too excited at this time." Yao Mo said tremblingly. He saw that his master and the young master of Tianji Villa were soft-hearted and refused to take action, so he had to be the villain himself...
Di Feisheng also knew that Yao Mo was telling the truth. When he saw Fang Duobing putting Li Lianhua back on the bed, he asked, "How could this happen?"
"The human brain is a very wonderful organ, and there are still many unknowns." The medicine demon himself didn't know it, so he hurriedly stepped forward to check his pulse again, and there was indeed one thing to be happy about: "Congratulations, Your Majesty, the poison of Bicha, the leader of the Li family, has been cured. As for..."
"Say!"
"As for Clan Leader Li's memory confusion, we can only ask after he wakes up."
"When will people wake up?"
"Maybe two hours, maybe until tomorrow morning, but we must be prepared." Yao Mo thought again, "There must be someone guarding Master Li."
"Okay, I will guard him!" Before Di Fei could say anything, Fang Duobing answered first. At the same time, he felt uncomfortable in his heart: Li Xiangyi, is it really Li Xiangyi who is back? If he doesn't remember Li Lianhua, what should I do? Do you really want to become a disciple?
Fang Duobing looked at Li Lianhua's fingertips that had turned white due to excessive exertion just now, wondering why he was so weak. He also thought that when Li Lianhua woke up again, he would have to give him some replenishment no matter what.
That's it, FangAs Du Bing was thinking wildly, the night passed. Li Lianhua would still call Di Feisheng's name from time to time and murmur to himself in a low voice. Fang Du Bing put his ear close to hear clearly. It turned out that he was still asking where Shan Gu Dao's body was?
Fang Duobing really wanted to pull out Shan Gudao and teach him a lesson at this time. Why did Shan Gudao not care about the sincerity that others were always pursuing? Not only do you not care, but you also trample on it for the sake of the illusory dream of rejuvenation? It’s really harmful to others!
Fortunately, I look nothing like him! If Li Xiangyi were his junior brother, Fang Duobing would probably wake up laughing from his dreams, and he would definitely hold the sweetest candy in the world in front of him. Even if it cost him his own life, Fang Duobing would not blink an eye.
In this way, another two hours passed. During this period, Di Feisheng came to see him once, Yao Mo came to check his pulse, and even Wuyan, who was usually invisible, came to see him from a distance. When only Fang Duobing was left to watch over him, Li Lianhua woke up.
"Where did Di Feisheng go?" This was the first sentence Li Lianhua said after waking up. The second sentence was: "Who are you?"
"I am Fang Duobing, and Shan Gudao is my uncle!" Fang Duobing was mentally prepared, and when he said these words, he felt very calm inside.
"Uncle?" Li Lianhua closed her eyes, as if recalling something. "Impossible, I just met him, he is only eight years old!"
"Ten years have passed." Fang Duobing decided to tell the truth.
Both Li Xiangyi and Li Lianhua are people with strong hearts. Although Li Lianhua likes to trick others, he hopes others will treat him sincerely.
"Ten years?!" Li Lianhua was shocked, turned over and tried to sit up, but found that her hands and feet were weak, "My legs?"
"Your legs are fine. I'll help you and sit up slowly." Fang Duobing sat next to Li Lianhua, using his arms to make Li Lianhua sit on him, and reached for the porridge on the low table next to the bed, which Wuyan had just brought.
"Drink some porridge! You haven't eaten all day and night." As he said this, he wanted to feed the porridge water into Li Lianhua's mouth with a spoon.
At this time, Li Lianhua was Li Xiangyi ten years ago. Li Xiangyi vaguely knew that the young man in front of him had taken care of him all night. He also said that he was his senior brother's nephew, and this man fed him porridge so tenderly. How could he betray the young man's kindness? He moved his left hand again, grabbed the bowl with the other hand, raised his neck and drank all the porridge in the bowl.
He actually had no appetite, and his senior brother's affairs made him anxious.
When he opened his eyes, ten years had passed. He was lying in bed and was so weak, but Di Feisheng watched his martial arts progress further! Where did the senior brother's body go?
Without answers to these questions, he didn't want to take a bite even if the dragon meat was placed in front of him, let alone porridge.
"I'm not a woman. Why should I be so pretentious? I don't need a spoon!" Li Xiangyi glanced at the young man and thought that the man should have fun.
"How about another bowl?" Fang Duobing didn't take Li Xiangyi's actions to heart. Li Xiangyi should have lived such a happy life, "I'll have to take medicine later."
"Call Di Feisheng and I want to ask him about my senior brother!"
"When you finish drinking the medicine, I'll tell you."
Seeing that he was so persistent, Fang Duobing had no choice but to put him back on the bed and go out to get the tonic that the medicine demon had simmered on the stove.
